project.name: AI Novelist & Audiobook (Writer's Atelier)
project.type: Multi-Platform AI Writing Suite (Flask Web + Native Android Mobile)
project.description: An integrated workbench for co-writing novels and courseware with any LLM and producing studio-grade neural audiobooks. Features real-time token streaming console, sliding-window context, dynamic worldview, multi-key/multi-model Gemini rotation, VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo offline neural speech synthesis, and an Android Kotlin Material 3 mobile application.

web.frontend: Vanilla CSS + Vanilla JS + Jinja2 + SSE

android.ui_framework: Jetpack Compose + Material 3 (Material You Dynamic Colors)
android.tts_engine: VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo (ONNX Runtime 1.20.0 XNNPACK FP32 + Sea-G2P JNI)
android.background_execution: Android Foreground Service with Partial WakeLock

tables.name: novels
tables.description: Stores novel projects, genres, languages (vi/en), status, and lore

tables.name: chapters
tables.description: Stores individual chapter texts, word count, audio path, and generation status

tables.name: outlines
tables.description: Stores generated outline texts and planned chapter titles

tables.name: audio_tracks
tables.description: Stores synthesized audio files, sample rate (48kHz), duration, and RTF metrics

tables.name: voice_presets
tables.description: Stores VieNeu-TTS voice profiles, regions (Bắc/Trung/Nam), styles, and sample audio URIs

tables.name: api_keys
tables.description: Stores masked keys, SHA-256 hashes, and provider configs (encrypted in Keystore)

tables.name: quota_logs
tables.description: Stores active cooldowns and 30-hour exhaustion locks per (model, keyHash) pair

android_room.relationships: novels (1:N) -> chapters (1:1) -> audio_tracks; novels (1:1) -> outlines (CASCADE delete)

key_features: Gemini multi-model multi-key rotation with smart 429 RPM/RPD distinction
Sliding-window context management (3 recent full chapters + distant summary + world lore)
6 ready-to-use writing templates (Web Novel, Literary, Hard Sci-Fi, Romance, Mystery, Custom)
Bilingual focus: Optimized exclusively for Vietnamese and English
VieNeu-TTS Voice Studio with instant sound sample previews
Zero Text Clipping Architecture for Compose UI across all font scales (1.0x to 2.0x)
Android Foreground Service with live notification progress and WakeLock
Dual Audio Player: 40-column real-time Waveform visualizer + lightweight voice sample previewer
Lossless 48kHz WAV audio export to Android MediaStore (Music/AINovelist) and Audiobook ZIP bundling
conventions: Phase plans in plans/ must be authored in English with a single comprehensive test per phase
After completing each phase, run only that single test for verification, then stop for user review
All Android source code resides strictly in AI-Novel-Android/
API keys are always hardware-encrypted and never stored in plain text
